title: Evening Round: one wrong note
intro: One note of this round has been changed, and now two voices clash. Find it and fix it. Keep the rhythm the same.
source: Written for Canon Workbench as a practice piece.
hints: Press ▶ next to an error to hear it. Both errors are on beat 3.
Under beats 3 and 4 of each phrase's first bar the chord is C major (C, E, G).
The wrong note is in the third phrase.
